subject: More colours than the machine has: multicolour

subject: Game AI: Patterns and states
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Patrols, reactions, states, transitions and timing. Experiment: Change when a guard pauses, looks around and resumes its route

subject: Game AI: Perception and knowledge
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Sight, hearing, limited knowledge, memory and belief. Experiment: Hide after being seen; compare pursuit of the current position with search around the last sighting

subject: Game AI: Movement and navigation
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Pursuit, escape, steering, avoidance, graphs and pathfinding. Experiment: Put a wall between a pursuer and its target and compare movement with route finding

subject: Game AI: Action selection
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Conditions, priorities, utility scores, weighted choices and stability of decisions. Experiment: Inspect the competing scores for attacking, retreating and seeking cover

subject: Game AI: Looking ahead
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Game trees, evaluation, minimax, pruning and bounded search. Experiment: Compare immediate and future consequences in a small board game

subject: Game AI: Coordination
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Separation, flocking, shared information, roles and cooperation. Experiment: Compare independent pursuers with entities that spread out or share a sighting

subject: Game AI: Behaviour design and debugging
why: Craft Game AI sequence, not yet authored: Visible intentions, predictability, deliberate mistakes, fairness and inspectable decisions. Experiment: Show the current state, known facts and reason for a decision while changing one rule

subject: Game Feel: Jumping and forgiveness
why: Craft Game Feel sequence, not yet authored: Jump profiles, air control, variable height, buffered jumps and coyote time. Experiment: Compare the same gap with one rule changed

subject: Game Feel: Impact and feedback
why: Craft Game Feel sequence, not yet authored: Animation timing, sound, recoil, hit pauses and visual emphasis. Experiment: Compare one hit with individual feedback layers enabled

subject: Game Feel: Cameras and attention
why: Craft Game Feel sequence, not yet authored: Framing, follow, lead, dead zones, tracking and shake. Experiment: Follow the same path with different camera rules

subject: Game Feel: Readability and anticipation
why: Craft Game Feel sequence, not yet authored: Silhouette, contrast, warnings, action phases and competing cues. Experiment: Read an incoming threat before acting

subject: Game Feel: Failure and recovery
why: Craft Game Feel sequence, not yet authored: Checkpoints, respawns, protection, retries, input gates and ending transitions. Experiment: Compare the time and actions needed to recover from the same failure

subject: Game Design module
why: Agreed Craft module with no lessons yet (Agreed module; lessons not authored). Rules, goals, choices, resources, challenge, levels and progression; why a functioning game is interesting.

subject: Game Data and Algorithms module
why: Agreed Craft module with no lessons yet (Agreed module; lessons not authored). Represent game worlds and entities; compare operations, algorithms and their costs.

subject: Graphics and Animation module
why: Agreed Craft module with no lessons yet (Agreed module; lessons not authored). Create images and animation; connect pixels, sprites, tiles, palettes, fonts and rendering to the intended result.

subject: Sound and Music module
why: Agreed Craft module with no lessons yet (Agreed module; lessons not authored). Create effects and music through rhythm, melody, synthesis and arrangement, connected to hardware facilities.
